English: Curtained Tent
A simple but dignified tent, adorned with colored curtains, marking the leaders place among the encampment.
Mosaic-Floor Hut
A sturdier hut with decorative mosaic tiling, signifying wealth and stability in the midst of the steppe.
Silk Draped Shelter
A prestigious tent covered in imported silks, providing comfort and status for the clans ruler.
Columned Pavilion
A mobile structure with ornate columns, echoing imperial luxury even in the field.
Gilded Portico
A lavish entrance to the rulers quarters, adorned with gold leaf and intricate designs, signifying true imperial grandeur.
Domed Chamber
A grand domed hall reminiscent of Constantinoples splendor, providing unmatched prestige to the nomadic ruler.
Imperial Reception Hall
A majestic tent-palace where great envoys and chieftains are received, echoing the imperial court.
Throne Room
The heart of the mobile empire: a resplendent throne room, hung with purple and gold, where the Khan-Emperor commands the clans.
Courtiers Gallery
A lavish tented gallery where the noblest courtiers, scholars, and artists gather, enhancing culture and unity in the realm.
Byzantine Grand Palace
A colossal, mobile palace, rivaling the splendor of Constantinople itself. The heart of imperial authority on the open steppe, awe-inspiring to friend and foe alike.
